status: Design-authored proposals only. Not ground truth. Results on this corpus are diagnostic until qualified language and curriculum review is complete.
split_policy:
(frozen before any model was run on this corpus):
- Skill cases: each of the 30 skills has seven distinct questions, one per language form. For the
  skill at sorted index i, the forms at positions (3i, 3i+1, 3i+2) mod 7 go to the test split and
  the other four to development. Each question is its own group; no case is a translation of
  another, so no translation pair can straddle the split.
- Interaction cases: each carries an explicit group_id. Cases sharing a group (for example the
  Sinhala and Singlish forms of one fraction question) always land in the same split. Groups are
  assigned to splits alternately within each category in authoring order.
